attributes.name: Scarab of Mummy Defense
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to examine the top card of your location deck. If it has the Undead trait, you may explore your location.

Bury this card to banish any number of cards that have the Curse trait displayed next to the deck of a character at your location.
